title: The Kalopaideia Diploma in Reading Gaulish Epigraphy
instructions: Ninety minutes, no notes. A printed lexicon and reference grammar are permitted for Sections B and C. Honor code: you affirm by submitting that you used only permitted aids. A failed examination may be retaken after thirty days.

items.prompt_en: Translate this line from the Coligny Calendar.
reference: samonios three-night festival of samo today

items.prompt_en: Translate this phrase from the Larzac Tablet.
reference: in the sacred place to the cantobednna invokes
into alkunom to cantobednna calls upon
in the sacred place invokes the cantobednna

items.prompt_en: Translate this opening from the Chamalières Tablet.
reference: great god maponos of the arverni kings curse curse
very divine maponos of arverni kings curse curse
andedion maponos of the arverni kings curse curse

items.prompt_en: Translate this Lepontic text from the Vercelli bilingual stone.
reference: to akanonetivis to the deceased to the youth
to akanonetivis tankinom for the youth
akanonetivis to the monument to the young man

items.prompt: Parse SEGOMĀRI. Give: case, number, lexical form (nominative).
Parse DEDEMIT. Give: person, number, tense.
Parse LVGVO. Give: case, number, lexical form (nominative).
What is the dative plural ending for all Gaulish noun classes?
Which script is the oldest used for Celtic epigraphy?
What does the digraph <ou> represent in Gaulish?
Which month began the Gaulish year according to the Coligny Calendar?
What does MID mean in the Coligny Calendar?
Which Gaulish god was identified with Roman Mercury?
What does IEVRV mean in votive inscriptions?

honor_code: I attest that the answers I have entered are my own, composed without aid beyond the materials permitted for each section of this examination. I understand that this examination is graded, that the script and my signed attestation will be hashed on completion, and that a passing score will issue a permanent on-chain diploma in my name.
